list.name: device
list.label: Device
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: v.defaultBucket, tag: "device_id", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "climate", start: -30d)

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "climate" and r._field == "temperature")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.device_id, set: ${device:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "climate" and r._field == "humidity")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.device_id, set: ${device:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
